note: Reviewed CDB90 match 4, pinned revision e0b35ec4d798cec3bb4e6970c0f6bb7aa69e2f4c. CDB90 (CAA Database of Battles, Version 1990), tidy data maintained by Jeffrey B. Arnold. Original US Army Concepts Analysis Agency data; revised data licensed ODC-BY. Original force designations and strength interpretations are retained with each quantity. Each side is one aggregate force, including any coalition; its total is not allocated among members. Personnel casualties are not deaths. Source estimates and adjudged error margins are not statistical confidence intervals. Equipment and tactical movements are not established by this dataset. Match review: Exact named battle on 25 April 1626 (15 April Julian in the contemporary broadside). Both complete source forces remain local. PROT UNION ARMY is an anachronistic source label: the Union dissolved in 1621. The original CDB total is attached to Mansfeld's field army, identified by source commander and contemporary narrative, not to a revived Union or a guessed polity. Identity review (attacker; original CDB90 name PROT UNION ARMY): CDB PROT UNION ARMY / MANSFIELD is retained in provenance. The contemporary 1626 report calls the defeated force Mansfeld's army; NDB dates the Union's dissolution to 1621. This corrects the local force label without splitting or changing the CDB total. Identity review (defender; original CDB90 name IMP ARMY): CDB IMP ARMY / WALLENSTEIN identifies the same complete field force named in the contemporary account; no national subdivision or quantity change.
